summary: Stablecoin Development Corp filed an 8-K reporting amendments to October 2025 Pre-Funded Warrants held by R01 Fund LP and Framework Ventures IV L.P., removing exercisability restrictions. Both warrant holders fully exercised their warrants on a cashless basis, receiving 11,307,300 shares each (total 22,614,600 shares) after withholding 24,720 shares as exercise price. Post-exercise, shares outstanding became 50,449,780. The filing is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. No premium, board recommendation, or strategic context provided. Watch for potential dilution impacts but no arbitrage angle.
